item.description: Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for architecture diagrams, built for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It suits developers who want to turn a codebase or system description into an interactive diagram inside an AI coding agent.

item.title: [github_trending] k1tbyte/Wand-Enhancer
item.description: WandEnhancer is an open-source interoperability extension that patches a local Wand (WeMod) installation and injects a version.dll proxy to flip Electron's ASAR-integrity fuse byte, extending configs and UX without an update or telemetry service. The maintainers warn there are no official YouTube tutorials or prebuilt .exe files; third-party downloads may contain malware/password stealers, so use only official GitHub releases.

item.title: [github_trending] jingyaogong/minimind
item.description: MiniMind is an open-source project that trains a ~64M-parameter language model from scratch in about 2 hours for roughly ¥3 of compute; the main minimal release is about 1/2700 the size of GPT-3 and is designed to run on an ordinary consumer GPU. It's a practical baseline for developers and students who want to reproduce the full pretraining pipeline at very low cost.
